analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 68.7 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram slightly worsened to 0.2139. Despite maintaining an uptrend for 5 consecutive days, the current price of $35.12 is at 96.4% of the 52-week high of $35.45, indicating potential overheating. The ADX at 35.4 confirms a clear trend, but the 4-hour RSI at 70.9 is approaching overbought levels. Entry will be considered only after a confirmed breakout above the 5-day high of $35.45.
